title: Sections on a zero-dimensional scheme are the product of the geometric stalks
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and $C$ a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with $\dim C\le0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For each point $c\in|C|$ choose a geometric point $\bar c:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_c\to C$ lying over $c$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Then $|C|$ is finite, and for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] the map
$$\gamma_{C,F}:F(C)\longrightarrow\prod_{c\in|C|}F_{\bar c},\qquad a\longmapsto(a_{\bar c})_{c},$$
sending a global section to its germs at the pointed etale neighbourhoods $(C,\bar c)$ (stalks of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]), is an isomorphism of abelian groups, natural in $F$. (This names the map of the degree-$0$ identification in lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-cohomology.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 03QO (lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian): for a strictly henselian local ring $R$, $\Gamma(\Spec R,\mathcal F)=\mathcal F_{\bar s}$; applied to the local Artinian pieces $\Spec\mathcal O_{C,c}$ (algebra.tex Lemma Tag 00KH: a Noetherian ring of dimension 0 is Artinian, a finite product of local Artinian rings; Section Tag 04GE, an Artinian local ring is complete hence henselian, Lemma Tag 04GM; residue field $k$ by the Nullstellensatz), with the sheaf axiom for the finite Zariski cover by disjoint open points
